# copilot-instructions.md

This file provides guidance to GitHub Copilot when working with code in this repository.

The project overview, directory layout, coding conventions, and testing strategy
are maintained in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md). Read that file before making any
change and treat it as the single source of truth. This file deliberately keeps
no copy of those rules, because the duplicate had drifted from the original.

For the development environment setup and the build, test, and lint procedures,
see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
